blurb:
Skip the tourist traps and taste why Downtown Houston wears the crown as the most internationally influenced food scene in Texas, one bite at a time.

The walk starts at the Historic Clock Tower before diving into an Italian Cajun fusion masterpiece: smokey crumbled spicy boudin, thick cut crispy bacon, and melted cheese on a toasted crust. From there, stroll through Market Square Park, a living testament to the city's transformation and growth, then head into Houston's subterranean Underground for Brisket Eggrolls, a bold Asian Southern mashup. A walk down Main Street brings street art and urban energy before a stop at a local Houstonian favorite for a Quesabirria Taco. The tour wraps at the Historic POST Market with a sweet treat and rooftop views to cool down, plus a mystery Secret Dish revealed only on the day

By the end, you'll have tasted five of Houston's most talked about bites and picked up a real feel for the culture and traditions behind them.
